propositions: Negative caplog assertions (assert not ...) pass vacuously when zero records are captured, silently losing 100% coverage with no test failure or output indication.

Logger propagation disabled globally via logging.getLogger('rebar').propagate=False in configure_logging() or import-time side effects causes downstream caplog assertions to silently fail to capture any records.
Logger level raised to WARNING via install_stderr_handler().setLevel(WARNING) silently drops INFO-level records at the originating logger, bypassing caplog.at_level(INFO) which cannot rescue them.
Test execution order affects whether assertions are void or live, making coverage non-deterministic across parallel runs with different worker distributions.
Five negative caplog assertions in the codebase are structurally vulnerable to silent void states when logger state is poisoned by earlier test execution.
